blocks.block_content: Proposition 1. Consider the uncertain quadrotor model (36), the safety function (37) with the safe set  \( C_{S} \) , the backup controller (38), and the backup set  \( C_{B} \)  in (39). If the controller gains  \( k_{\vartheta} > 0 \) ,  \( k_{\omega} > 0 \)  and the design parameters  \( P_{\vartheta} = P_{\vartheta}^{T} \succ 0 \) ,  \( Q_{\vartheta} = Q_{\vartheta}^{T} \succ 0 \) ,  \( \varrho_{\vartheta} > 0 \) ,  \( \vartheta_{r} \in (0, \vartheta_{\max}) \) ,  \( r_{x}, r_{z} > 0 \) , and  \( r_{\vartheta} \in (0, \vartheta_{\max}^{2}) \) , with  \( \bar{\vartheta} < \pi/2 \) , are chosen such that
blocks.label: Text

\boldsymbol {A} _ {\vartheta} \left(a _ {J} ^ {-}\right) ^ {\top} \boldsymbol {P} _ {\vartheta} + \boldsymbol {P} _ {\vartheta} \boldsymbol {A} _ {\vartheta} \left(a _ {J} ^ {-}\right) \preceq - \boldsymbol {Q} _ {\vartheta},
\]
blocks.label: Formula

\boldsymbol {A} _ {\vartheta} (a _ {J} ^ {+}) ^ {\top} \boldsymbol {P} _ {\vartheta} + \boldsymbol {P} _ {\vartheta} \boldsymbol {A} _ {\vartheta} (a _ {J} ^ {+}) \preceq - \boldsymbol {Q} _ {\vartheta},

blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: Proof. We first consider the pitch dynamics. On the set  \( C_{B} \) ,  \( h_{\vartheta,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) \geq 0 \)  implies  \( y_{\vartheta}^{\top} P_{\vartheta} y_{\vartheta} \leq \varrho_{\vartheta} \) , and hence
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: |\vartheta - \vartheta_{\rm r}| \leq \Delta_\vartheta, \ \ \left| \bs{K}_\vartheta \bs{y}_\vartheta \right| \leq \Delta_M.
blocks.label: Formula

blocks.block_content: Thus, by the fourth and fifth conditions in (40), the pitch angle satisfies  \( 0 \leq \vartheta \leq \bar{\vartheta} \leq \sqrt{\vartheta_{\max}^{2} - r_{\vartheta}} \)  on  \( C_{B} \) . Moreover, the third condition in (40) yields  \( |K_{\vartheta}y_{\vartheta}| \leq M_{\max} \) , and hence the moment saturation in (38) is inactive on  \( C_{B} \) .
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: We next verify the robust invariance of the pitch dynamics
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: under the backup controller, which satisfy
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content:
\[
\dot {\boldsymbol {y}} _ {\vartheta} = \boldsymbol {A} _ {\vartheta} (a _ {J} (\boldsymbol {\theta})) \boldsymbol {y} _ {\vartheta} + \boldsymbol {b} _ {\vartheta} \delta_ {\ell} F _ {\max}.
\]
blocks.label: Formula

blocks.block_content: Since  \( \boldsymbol{A}_{\vartheta}(a) \)  depends affinely on a, the first two conditions in (40) imply
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content:
\[
\boldsymbol {A} _ {\vartheta} (a) ^ {\top} \boldsymbol {P} _ {\vartheta} + \boldsymbol {P} _ {\vartheta} \boldsymbol {A} _ {\vartheta} (a) \preceq - \boldsymbol {Q} _ {\vartheta}, \quad \forall a \in [ a _ {J} ^ {-}, a _ {J} ^ {+} ].
\]
blocks.label: Formula

blocks.block_content: Therefore, with \(V_{\vartheta} \triangleq \pmb{y}_{\vartheta}^{\top} \pmb{P}_{\vartheta} \pmb{y}_{\vartheta}\), we have
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: |\vartheta - \vartheta_{\rm r}| \leq \Delta_\vartheta, \ \ \left| \bs{K}_\vartheta \bs{y}_\vartheta \right| \leq \Delta_M.
blocks.label: Formula

blocks.block_content: On the boundary  \( h_{\vartheta,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x})=0 \) , we have  \( V_{\vartheta}=\varrho_{\vartheta} \) , and hence  \( \|y_{\vartheta}\|\geq\sqrt{\varrho_{\vartheta}/\lambda_{\max}(P_{\vartheta})}>0 \) . Therefore, by the sixth condition in (40),  \( \bar{V}_{\vartheta}\leq0 \)  on the boundary of the zero superlevel set of  \( h_{\vartheta,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) \) . Equivalently,  \( \dot{h}_{\vartheta,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x})\geq0 \)  on this boundary, and the pitch component of  \( C_{B} \)  is robustly forward invariant.
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: We now consider the horizontal component of the motion. Since  \( 0 \leq \vartheta \leq \bar{\vartheta} < \pi/2 \)  on  \( C_{B} \) , the horizontal dynamics of (36) under (38) satisfy
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content:
\dot v_x =
    a_m(\bs{\theta}) F_{\max} \sin(\vartheta) - c_x v_x.
blocks.label: Formula

blocks.block_content: On the boundary  \( h_{v_{x},\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x})=0 \) , we have  \( v_{x}=0 \) , and therefore
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content:
\dot h_{v_x,\rm b}(\bs{x}) =
    a_m(\bs{\theta}) F_{\max} \sin(\vartheta) \geq 0,
blocks.label: Formula

blocks.block_content: where we used  \( a_{m}(\boldsymbol{\theta}) > 0 \)  and  \( \vartheta \geq 0 \) . Hence, the  \( v_{x} \)  component of  \( C_{B} \)  is robustly forward invariant. Moreover, on  \( C_{B} \) ,  \( v_{x} \geq 0 \) , and hence  \( h_{x,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) = v_{x} \geq 0 \) . Therefore, the surface clearance component of  \( C_{B} \)  is robustly forward invariant.
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: We next consider the altitude component of the motion. On the boundary  \( h_{v_{z},\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) = 0 \) , we have  \( v_{z} = 0 \) , and the vertical dynamics of (36) satisfy
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content:
\dot h_{v_z,\rm b}(\bs{x})  = \dot v_z
    & = -g_0 - \delta_g + a_m(\bs{\theta})F_{\max}\cos(\vartheta)
    \\
    & \geq -g_0 - \delta_g^{+} + a_m^{-}F_{\max}\cos(\bar\vartheta)
    \geq 0,
blocks.label: Formula

blocks.block_content: where we used  \( 0 \leq \vartheta \leq \bar{\vartheta} < \pi/2 \)  and the seventh condition in (40). Therefore, the  \( v_{z} \)  component of  \( C_{B} \)  is robustly forward invariant. Furthermore, on  \( C_{B} \) ,  \( v_{z} \geq 0 \) , thus  \( \dot{h}_{z,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) = v_{z} \geq 0 \) , and the altitude clearance component of  \( C_{B} \)  is also robustly forward invariant.
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: Finally, we show that  \( C_{B} \subseteq C_{S} \) . Since  \( h_{x,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) \geq 0 \)  and  \( h_{z,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) \geq 0 \) , we have  \( h_{x}(\boldsymbol{x}) \geq r_{x} \)  and  \( h_{z}(\boldsymbol{x}) \geq r_{z} \) . Moreover, by the fifth condition in (40),  \( h_{\vartheta,\mathrm{b}}(\boldsymbol{x}) \geq 0 \)  implies  \( h_{\vartheta}(\boldsymbol{x}) = \vartheta_{\max}^{2} - \vartheta^{2} \geq r_{\vartheta} \) . Therefore, by the last condition in (40), the smooth minimum safety function (37) satisfies  \( h(\boldsymbol{x}) \geq 0 \)  for all  \( x \in C_{B} \) , i.e.,  \( C_{B} \subseteq C_{S} \) .
blocks.label: Text

blocks.block_content: Combining the pitch, horizontal, and altitude invariance results with the input admissibility and  \( C_{B} \subseteq C_{S} \) , the backup controller (38) renders the backup set (39) robustly forward invariant for (36) for all  \( \theta \in \Theta \) . ☐
